## Statement of changes (Apache-2.0 §4b)

`SKILL.md` bodies are redistributed verbatim — not edited, reformatted or
translated. This project adds only derived metadata alongside them: tags, a
quality score, size statistics and duplicate clustering, all produced by
`tools/build.py`. No upstream file is modified.
